top: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city,
bottom: wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons...

top: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity...
bottom: ...he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

top: The LORD is good, a strong hold
bottom: in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

top: Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables,
bottom: that he may run that readeth it.

top: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save,
bottom: he will rejoice over thee with joy...

top: ...will be unto her a wall of fire round about,
bottom: and will be the glory in the midst of her.

top: ...I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee,
bottom: and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.
